name: Naimur Edit My Account Page for WooCommerce
author: Naimur Rahman Nahid

sections.description:
Naimur Edit My Account Page for WooCommerce transforms the default WooCommerce My Account dashboard into a clean, modern, card-style UI.

This plugin enhances user navigation with:

  • Beautiful left sidebar with gradient background
  • Icon-based menu items
  • Smooth hover effects
  • White “active” pill-style highlight
  • Clean content area with soft shadows
  • 100% responsive layout
  • Loads only on WooCommerce My Account pages
  • No template overrides—fully CSS-based

Perfect for WooCommerce stores wanting a premium, professional look without custom coding.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Ensure the WooCommerce My Account page is published and assigned.
  4. Visit /my-account on the frontend to see the new design.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin override WooCommerce templates?

No. It uses CSS and WordPress hooks only—no template files are replaced.

Will it work with any theme?

Yes, the UI is enforced using high-specificity selectors and !important rules when needed.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The stylesheet loads only on My Account pages.

Can I customize the design?

Yes. You can override the CSS from your theme or use a custom CSS plugin.

Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin includes a dependency header:
Requires Plugins: woocommerce
